problems.reason: Different weight estimates for Aragosaurus (25 t vs. 20 t).
Different age ranges: early Berriasian (145–140 Ma) vs. Kimmeridgian–Tithonian (154.8–143.1 Ma).

Both sentences mention that Aragosaurus, like Camarasaurus, had large holes/spatulate teeth.
